body:
qPCR (6 plates)

| qPCR Plates |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | per well in 384 | per 384-well plate | for 6 plates (x440) |
| NF water | 2.91 μL | 1.12 mL | 7.68 mL |
| 5x Phusion HF buffer | 1.25 μL | 480 μL | 3.3 mL |
| 10mM e dNTP | 0.25 μL | 96 μL | 660 μL |
| NCAP\_F 100μM  | 0.025 μL | 9.6 μL | 66 μL |
| NCAP\_R 100μM  | 0.025 μL | 9.6 μL | 66 μL |
| MgCl2 (50mM) | 0.0325 μL | 12.48 μL | 85.8 μL |
| Hot Start Phusion DNA Pol | 0.0375 μL | 14.4 μL | 99 μL |
| 100x SYBR (final 1:200) | 0.06 μL | 23.04 μL | 158.4 μL |
| Total | 4.59 μL | 1.765 mL | 12.1155 mL |

To prepare 100x SYBR Green: add 5μL 10,000x SYBR Green into 500μL DMSO, which can be found in Phusion DNA Pol kits. Avoid light. Manually load 122μL mix into each well of a 96-well plate (AB0765), then transfer 4.5μL/well into 6x 384-well plates (LightCycler 384).

*TF Dilution Buffer*

500 mL

| 1 M Tris-HCl pH 8 | 5 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| BSA | 0.5 g |
| KCl | 5.59 g |
| Ethylene Glycol | 250 mL |
| 100 mM ZnSO4.H2O | 50 uL |

*Elution Buffer*

0.1% Tween, 10 mM Tris pH7.8, 1 mM MgCl2 (0.5mM in PCR rxn)  
   
500 mL buffer:  
\-    	500 uL Tween20  
\-    	5 mL Tris pH 8  
\-    	500 uL 1M MgCl2

| 10X Wash Buffer |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | STOCK | Final 10x: | 2 L |
| Tris pH 7.5 | 1M | 50mM | 100 mL |
| EDTA | 0.5M | 50mM | 200 mL |

*1.55X SELEX buffer*

*1.55x Promega Buffer, 155μM EGTA, 1.55mM DTT, 3μM ZnSO4 (no dIdC)*

200 mL

| Promega Buffer 1.55 (10X) | 31 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| EGTA (0.5 M) | 62 uL |
| DTT (1 M) | 310 uL |
| ZnSO4 (100 mM) | 6 uL |

Make up the volume to 200 mL and filter the solution. Store at 4 degrees.  
Aliquot 8.5 uL of 1.55X SELEX Buffer per well of NUNC 384-well plates

*1X SELEX buffer*

*1x Promega Buffer, 100μM EGTA, 1mM DTT, 3μM ZnSO4 (no dIdC)*

250 mL

| Promega Buffer 1 (10X) | 25 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| EGTA (0.5 M) | 50 uL |
| DTT (1 M) | 250 uL |
| ZnSO4 (100 mM) | 7.5 uL |

Make up the volume to 250 mL and filter the solution. Store at 4 degrees.

*Protein Plate Preparation*

Take about 2 ug of protein for the following proteins:

- CTCF  
- cMYC  
- cMYC \+ MAX  
- cMYC:MAX (Recombinant complex)

10X TCAPT Buffer

| 1.4 M KCl | 208.74 g |
| :---- | :---- |

| 10 mM MgCl2 | 20 mL |
| 1 mM EGTA | 4 mL |
| 100 mM Tris-HCl pH 8 | 200 mL |
| Tween20 | 20 mL |
| 30 uM ZnSO4.H2O | 600 uL |

0.5 M EGTA ⇒ 1.90 g EGTA in 10 mL 1 M NaOH → 1.9 g EGTA \+ 9 mL sterile water \+ 1 mL 10 M NaOH
